top_signals.title: New Middle East Threats, Russian Diesel Coming to US
top_signals.summary: The news doesn’t stop when markets close. Hosts David Gura, Christina Ruffini and Lisa Mateo bring clarity, context and a bit of humor to the weekend’s biggest headlines, LIVE from New York. Joined by The New Yorker Staff Writer Gideon Lewis-Kraus, Linx Dating Founder & CEO Amy Andersen, Oliver Wyman Geostrategy Practice Partner & Global Head Daniel Tannebaum, Seaport Research Partners Chief Equity Strategist Jonathan Golub, SHRM President and CEO Johnny C. Taylor Jr, The Wall Street Journal Foreign Correspondent and “This Cursed Beautiful Land” Author Evan Gershkovich, The Atlantic CEO and “The Running Ground” Author Nicholas Thompson and “Sleuth-Hound” Author Lindsey Fitzharris. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
